errors.queueFull: Too many requests at once (increase the poll interval)
errors.noValue: No answer for __elm__ (does the operand or function block exist in the device?)
errors.noElementInMsg: Nothing to read: msg.topic or msg.payload = e.g. "MW3" or "M1, MW(1,8), STATE"
errors.noWriteTarget: No target: msg.topic = operand (e.g. "MW3") or msg.payload = {MW3: 42, M5: 1}
errors.badRequestPath: msg.payload must be an API address, e.g. "/api/get/data?elm=CYC"
errors.noAction: No action: select one in the dialog or set msg.action (__list__)
errors.needStop: Only possible in STOP (run the STOP action first)
errors.netRange: NET ID must be between 0 and 8
errors.rangeOrder: Range: end must be greater than or equal to start
errors.noAll: "All" exists only for I, Q, AI, AO and M (not for __type__)
errors.fbName: Function block name missing or invalid (e.g. T, C, A, AC)
errors.fbInst: Function block number must be between 1 and 255
errors.fbWritePinType: Only inputs can be written: pin type 0 (bit) or 2 (word)
errors.fbPin: Pin number must be between 0 and 63
errors.badElement: Not understood: '__text__' (examples: MW3, MW(1,8), N(2;5), STATE, T1(2;0))
errors.invalidValue: Invalid value: number or true/false expected
errors.notWritable: __type__ cannot be written via the JSON API (only M, MB, MW, MD, N, NB, NW, ND and function block inputs)
errors.badDate: Date/time in msg.payload not readable (empty = now, timestamp or e.g. "2026-10-18 12:00:00")
errors.tls: HTTPS connection to __host__ failed (__msg__): encryption or certificate not accepted. Uncheck “Verify certificate” or try protocol http.

http.400: Request rejected (400): unknown or misspelled command
http.401: Login rejected (401): check user/password or API key
http.403: Not allowed (403): check the rights in easySoft 7/8; name/date/time only in STOP, function block values only in RUN
http.404: Not found (404): is the web server of the easyE4 enabled?
http.501: Not implemented (501): function not available in this firmware
http.503: easyE4 busy (503): try again later or poll less often
http.401adm: No permission (401): only the user "admin" may change the device name and admin settings (log in with user + password)
http.401set: No permission (401): this user is not allowed to do this – check the rights in easySoft (write markers, mode, clock)

apiError.32: This function block type does not exist
apiError.33: This function block number does not exist in the program
apiError.34: Pin type does not fit this function block
apiError.35: Pin number does not fit this function block
apiError.36: Word input is not connected to a constant in the program
apiError.unknown: API error __code__ (see Eaton documentation "API Error Codes")

label.verifyCert: Verify certificate (only with your own valid certificate)
label.seconds: seconds (0 = only on incoming message, otherwise min. 0.5)

mode.all: All (I, Q, AI, AO or M)

tips.device: In easySoft 7/8 (project → web server) the web server must be on (Web server enabled, Always enabled). For inputs/outputs also Enable read I/O, for reading without login Anonymous read access allowed. To write, create a user with write permission.
tips.read: The node fetches the values itself: at fixed intervals (Poll every) and/or on every incoming message.
tips.write: Only M, MB, MW, MD, the NET markers N, NB, NW, ND and function block inputs (firmware 1.20 or later) can be written. Inputs and outputs (I, Q, AI, AO) cannot be set. The user needs write permission and an enabled marker range in easySoft 7/8.
tips.fbWrite: Bit inputs must not be connected in the program, word inputs must be connected to a constant. Times always in milliseconds. Only in RUN.

tip.msg: The action comes from msg.action: run, stop, setClock, setDate, setTime, setName, saveFB, request.
tip.setClock: Sets date and time. Without msg.payload the current Node-RED time, otherwise e.g. "2026-10-18 12:00:00". Only possible in STOP.
tip.setDate: Like date + time, but only the date. Only in STOP.
tip.setTime: Like date + time, but only the time. Only in STOP.
tip.setName: New name from the field or from msg.payload. Only in STOP.
tip.saveFB: Function block constants changed via the JSON API are kept after a restart (firmware 1.20 or later).
tip.request: msg.payload is an API address, e.g. /api/get/data?elm=CYC. The answer is passed unchanged in msg.payload.
